scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build/ios -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath .build/SourcePackages CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- LETM3GO_COMMIT=$(sh scripts/source-commit.sh) build
scripts.ios:sync:production: npm run release:check && VITE_APNS_ENVIRONMENT=production npm run ios:sync && node scripts/check-release.mjs --synced
scripts.test:native: mkdir -p .build && swiftc -module-cache-path .build/swift-test-cache ios/App/App/AppleAuthCore.swift ios/App/App/RecorderCore.swift ios/App/App/WatchActivityCore.swift ios/App/App/MapCameraCore.swift ios/App/App/MapOverviewCore.swift ios/App/App/AdaptiveLocationCore.swift ios/App/App/QuietRestCore.swift tests/native/main.swift -o .build/recorder-tests && .build/recorder-tests
